descriptions.description:
A dataset containing 17208657 species occurrences available in GBIF matching the query:
{
 "and" : [
 "KingdomKey is Plantae",
 "HasCoordinate is true",
 "HasGeospatialIssue is false",
 "OccurrenceStatus is Present",
 "Year is greater than or equal to 1940",
 "Geometry POLYGON((-25.0 -36.0, 56.0 -36.0, 56.0 40.0, -25.0 40.0, -25.0 -36.0))"
 ]
}

 The dataset includes 17208657 records from 1676 constituent datasets; see https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/download/0014627-260903145123482/datasets/export for details.
 
Data from some individual datasets included in this download may be licensed under less restrictive terms.
